description.value: Hotel DeOro is an owner-operated hotel situated in historic downtown Lillooet, BC, in business since 2005 with décor reflecting the character of this mountain town on the Fraser River. Guests have access to a fully-equipped shared kitchen and dining area built in 2017, along with self check-in and individual rooms featuring flat-screen TVs, mini fridges, and free Wi-Fi. Local restaurants are within a 5-minute walk, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists passing through the Lillooet corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and corroborates OSM contact details (address 639 Main Street, phone 250.256.2355, same URL). Bike storage and cyclist-specific amenities are not mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so both required criteria remain null. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed ('FREE Wireless Internet' in every room), and nearby food is positively stated ('Most restaurants are only a 5 minute walk away').
concerns: No mention of bike storage anywhere on website or in OSM tags — both required criteria are unverifiable
Two different email addresses appear on the website: 'reservations@hoteldeoro.com' on the front page versus 'info@hoteldeoro.com' on About, Contact, and Rates pages; OSM lists info@hoteldeoro.com

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Hotel DeOro is a legitimate, active accommodation in cyclist-relevant Lillooet, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) can be confirmed from the website or OSM tags; direct outreach is needed before accreditation.
